mails.subject: Great to connect, and a 2,500 EUR idea
mails.body:
Hello,

It was a pleasure meeting some of your team at the networking evening earlier this month. Oakline Collective works with creative spaces across Europe, and we are putting together a shared programme of talks and pop-up days for the autumn.

We are looking for a limited number of venue partners. The participation fee is 2,500 EUR, which covers promotion in our network and a place in the joint calendar. We think your space would be a great fit.

If you would like to know more, let me know and I will share the outline.

Best regards,
Marta Quinn
Oakline Collective
mails.justification: Vague partnership proposal that refers to a meeting that never happened and asks for a fee. The sender has no relationship with the space and the message was never requested.

mails.subject: Notice of non-compliance: annual filing fee outstanding
mails.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Our records indicate that the annual business filing fee for your organisation has not been received. In accordance with Regulation 14(b) of the Nordic Business Registry Framework, an outstanding fee of 1,450.00 DKK is now payable.

Please note the following details regarding your file:

Reference: NBC-2026-558302
Payment deadline: 2026-09-28
Late charge after deadline: 15 percent per week

To settle the amount and avoid enforcement proceedings, please access the secure payment portal below and enter the reference number together with your card details.

https://pay.nbca-registry.example/file/NBC-2026-558302

A receipt will be issued by email once the payment has been processed. If you believe this notice was sent in error, you may submit a statement via the portal within five working days; however, the payment obligation will remain in force until your submission has been reviewed.

Please be aware that continued non-payment may result in a notation on your business record, restricted access to registry services and referral to a debt collection agency.

This notice has been generated automatically. Replies to this address are not read.

Yours faithfully,
Department of Registry Compliance
Nordic Business Compliance Authority
mails.justification: Phishing using an official-sounding authority and a fake fee, with a payment link. The sender has no relationship with the space and the message was never requested.

mails.subject: Lancement de la saison : offre exclusive pour les professionnels
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Nous avons le plaisir de vous convier à l'ouverture de notre nouvelle boutique en ligne, dédiée aux fournitures et aux cadeaux pour entreprises, qui ouvrira ses portes le 22 octobre.

À cette occasion, nous organisons une présentation en ligne ouverte à tous, le 20 octobre à 17 h. Vous y découvrirez la nouvelle gamme de papeterie, de plantes d'intérieur et de cadeaux personnalisés pour les équipes et les clients.

Les premiers inscrits recevront un bon d'achat de 20 euros, valable sur une première commande.

Nous avons également préparé des tarifs dégressifs pour les commandes de groupe, ainsi qu'un service de livraison express dans toute l'Europe du Nord.

Pour réserver votre place et recevoir le lien de connexion, rendez-vous sur atelier-pommedor.example/lancement.

Nous espérons avoir le plaisir de vous compter parmi nous.

Cordialement,
L'équipe de l'Atelier Pomme d'Or

Vous recevez ce message car votre entreprise figure dans notre base de contacts professionnels.

mails.subject: 🌱 Free guest post for your blog (no catch!)
mails.body:
Hey friends! 👋

Ola here from Greenroom Digital. I've been reading your blog (the one about hybrid work, so good!) and I'd love to contribute a free article to it. I write for a bunch of workplace and wellbeing sites and I think your readers would enjoy it.

The only thing I ask: one natural link back to a resource page on our site. That's it! 🙌

A few ideas I have so far:
- 7 ways to make a small workspace feel calm
- What remote teams get wrong about community
- A simple guide to focus in open offices

If you prefer, I can also send a different topic. We also run a small paid package for permanent links on partner blogs, starting at 120 EUR per month, if that is ever of interest. 😉

Tell me which one you like and I'll send a draft this week!

Thanks so much,
Ola ✨
Greenroom Digital
mails.justification: Guest post and backlink pitch to a blog the sender claims to have read. The sender has no relationship with the space and the message was never requested.
